typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AGLTY_INDIV_ID as string,
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		Contact_Idinsertdate as string,
		Extract_date as string,
		HLTH_INSR_RSPDR_CD as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_customerid_sync*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
addADFId split(isNull(AGLTY_INDIV_ID)||isNull(CONTACT_ID)||(notEquals(iifNull(CONTACT_ID, 'NOT_NULL_check'), 'NOT_NULL_check') && not(in(['003', '00Q'], upper(substring(CONTACT_ID, 1, 3))))),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(RejectCondition, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@RejectCondition derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull(AGLTY_INDIV_ID)||isNull(CONTACT_ID), concat('ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: ', iif(isNull(AGLTY_INDIV_ID), 'AGLTY_INDIV_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'CONTACT_ID.', '')), ''),
       iif((notEquals(iifNull(CONTACT_ID, 'NOT_NULL_check'), 'NOT_NULL_check') && not(in(['003', '00Q'], upper(substring(CONTACT_ID, 1, 3))))), concat('ADF:INVALID "CONTACT_ID": CONTACT ID should begin with "003" or "00Q". Received CONTACT_ID: ', CONTACT_ID), ''))) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Customer_id__c = AGLTY_INDIV_ID,
		Id = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toContact
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Customer_id__c = AGLTY_INDIV_ID,
		Id = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toLead
toLead filter(rlike(upper(Id), `00Q.*`)) ~> FilterLead
toContact filter(rlike(upper(Id), `003.*`)) ~> FilterContact
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_customerid_sync_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> IntermOutput
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_customerid_sync_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectOutput
FilterContact sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_customerid_sync_Contact.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ContactOutput
FilterLead sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_customerid_sync_Lead.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LeadOutput
